    ## Objective
    
    Integrate the completed authorization slices, close cross-crate gaps, and update durable Codeoff documentation without adding new product scope.
    
    ## Scope
    
    - Add cross-crate behavior tests that exercise config → runtime grant → Turn/scheduled snapshot → MCP lease → provider call for both repository and organization scopes.
    - Add the public-repository regression fixture proving alias order cannot select `0xfe10` over the authoritative `fewensa` route/member.
    - Verify account-route ceilings, caller grants, access levels, tool annotations, query containment, returned-result containment, revocation, ambiguity, and legacy snapshot compatibility as one matrix.
    - Update Codeoff runtime/channel documentation, sample TOML, deployment/runbook guidance, scheduled-authorization documentation, error/diagnostic expectations, and rollback notes.
    - State the production migration sequence explicitly: deploy compatible code, update account/role routes, restart/health-check, explicitly update scheduled job, then run live acceptance.
    - Update the owning source documents first, then run `openwiki code --update --print`; review generated `AGENTS.md`/OpenWiki changes against source authority. Do not introduce OpenWiki automation.
    - Keep unrelated formatting, refactors, and stale-doc cleanup out of scope.
    
    ## Verification
    
    Run at minimum:
    
    ```bash
    cargo fmt --all -- --check
    cargo clippy -p codeoff-config -p codeoff-state -p codeoff-runtime -p codeoff-mcp -p codeoff-cli --all-targets -- -D warnings
    cargo test -p codeoff-config -p codeoff-state -p codeoff-runtime -p codeoff-mcp -p codeoff-channel-slack -p codeoff-cli
    ```
    
    Also run any repository-owned verification command discovered from current authority.
    
    ## Acceptance
    
    - The matrix is covered by behavior tests at owner boundaries, not only implementation-detail unit tests.
    - Documentation examples use structured scope and canonical `destructive`.
    - OpenWiki has no remaining drift for the changed behavior.
    - Full narrow Codeoff verification is green.
